alkapoan_bargin.m: Yeah, sure, twenty-five thousand and I take a couple of your fingers too?

alkapoan_lie_wh_10.m: You want the house for yourself? Now that is interesting. Most people shy away from that cursed glow, but I can see ambition in your eyes. Hm. I could let it go for forty thousand gold...but gold alone won't earn my trust. If I sell it to you, I need proof you can be useful to me.

alkapoan_lie_wh_20.m: There's a small matter I want handled. Do this, and the price will stay at forty thousand. Refuse, and I'll reconsider whether you're worth the trouble.
r: What do you want from me?

alkapoan_lie_wh_30.m: If you want the house, I'll need proof that you can handle business my way. There's a card dealer who runs games in the back of the tavern here in Brimhaven. He operates because I allow it. That means he owes me a regular fee, call it an 'operation tax' if you will.

alkapoan_lie_wh_40.m: He's late. Bring me what he owes, and don't let him wiggle out of it. I want every bit of the five thousand gold. When you return with the gold, I'll know you're serious, and the deed will be yours for forty thousand more.
r: I'll be right back. Keep that deed handy.

alkapoan_lie_wh_50.m: Sure thing! As soon as I see forty-five thousand gold, you will see the deed to the house. Remember, you have my 'operation tax' gold too.
r: Forty-five thousand?! I don't have that kind of gold.
Here, take the fourty-five thousand and give me the deed and the key.

alkapoan_nocmar_wh_10.m: Ah...so this is for Nocmar? The man who couldn't pay his debt and lost everything. And now you want me to just hand it back? Hah! If he wants redemption, let him pay double what he owed. Fifty thousand gold, no less. You bring me that much, and I'll give you the deed and the key.
r: Fifty thousand gold?! Are you nuts? How about twenty-five housand?
Fifty thousand gold? I don't have it.
Here, take the fifty thousand and give me the deed and the key.

alkapoan_nocmar_wh_give_deed.m: A pleasure doing business with you.

alkapoan_not_enough_gold.m: Well, then you better go find it.

brv_guard_captain_and_rich_man_10.m: [Laughs] You again. Welcome back, foolish child.
r: Laugh while you can. The captain is here and now you will get your deserved punishment!

brv_guard_captain_and_rich_man_30.m: Let's see who is laughing in the end. The captain came to talk, not arrest me. Now she owns a new horse and I will be earning a lot of money with the necessary repairing of the dam and later the food harvesting. I call this a win-win.

brv_guard_captain_and_rich_man_40.m: It seems Alkapoan's letters accidentally fell into a fire and I am sure some unknown evil spies from Loneford destroyed the dam. You better disappear soon, or I might find some evidence that you are the evil spy from Loneford.

brv_guard_captain_and_rich_man_50.m: You better disappear soon, or I might find some evidence that you are the evil spy from Loneford.
r: We are all reasonable people here. Let us settle this, shall we?

brv_richman_01.m: I do not remember inviting you to my house.
r: What do you know about the destruction of the dam?
I am sorry and will leave.

brv_richman_05.m: It is very sad that the dam was destroyed. But I don't know anything.

brv_richman_10.m: I... I.... know nothing. Really, it is the truth!
r: I don't believe a word you say. [Half-lie] The two brothers told me that you paid them for destroying the dam.
I found your coin bags, and you paid the brothers to destroy the dam. [Show the coin bags]

brv_richman_15.m: You again. I already told you that I know nothing about the destruction of the dam.
r: I don't believe a word you say. [Half-lie] The two brothers told me that you paid them for destroying the dam.
I found your coin bags, and you paid the brothers for destroying the dam. [Hand him the coin bags]

brv_richman_20.m:
[Breaks down]

I was bribed by the people of Loneford to sabotage the dam. Here are some letters I exchanged with them, that prove what I did.

[The handwriting looks like that of my brother.]
r: You were honest to me so I will not kill you, but I will tell the guard captain. (And you can't escape from Brimhaven without me seeing you.)
I stopped the two brothers from destroying the dam. Who else could have done it?

brv_richman_21.m:
I don't know. Maybe it was the deliverer of the letters.

[Oh no, it could have been Andor who destroyed the dam!]

brv_richman_25.m: Leave me alone. I will wait here for the guards to arrest me.

mg2_richman_10.m: Oh, I know that look on their faces. Someone here wants to order something discreet.
r: Indeed. I want to expand a basement.

mg2_richman_12.m: Hmm, I don't run a construction company, but you seem to have something unusual in mind. Well, I'm sure I can help you. For a reasonable amount of gold, of course.
r: Of course. It's about an abandoned property far in the southeast.
In the ice, on the summit.
Of Mt.Galmore. Well, if you don't want to do it...

mg2_richman_14.m: Not so fast. Of course I can help you. I'm just a little ... surprised.

mg2_richman_14c.m: What exactly do you have in mind?
r: Well, finally you're talking sensibly. Look, I want the following ...

mg2_richman_16.m: You give him a piece of paper with your ideas and instructions on how to build it.

mg2_richman_16b.m: Well, that's something different for a change. It will cost you 50,000 gold pieces.
r: Good. Of course I don't have the money with me. But I'll be back.
OK, here you get 50,000. Make something good out of it.
You get 25,000. Be happy, that's plenty.

mg2_richman_18.m: So be it. You will be amazed how quickly we work.

mg2_richman_20.m: Ah, my new homeowner. Do you like the renovation?

r: Oh, for the purposes of this conversation? Yeah, yeah I am. I want to talk to Alkapoan, not you!

talk_about_white_house_20.m: What do you want, foolish child?
r: I've collected your 'operation tax' from the dealer. Now let's finish our deal.
[lie] I want the glowing white house. I need a place to hide from my parents.
Nocmar has sent me to get back what was once his.

andor.1: My father Mikhail says that Andor has not been home since yesterday. I should go look for him in the village.
andor.10: Leonid tells me that he saw Andor talking to Gruil. I should go ask Gruil if he knows more.
andor.20: Gruil wants me to bring him a poison gland. Then he might talk more. He tells me that some poisonous snakes have such a gland.
andor.30: Gruil tells me that Andor was looking for someone called Umar. I should go ask his friend Gaela in Fallhaven to the east.
andor.40: I talked to Gaela in Fallhaven. He tells me to go see Bucus and ask about the Thieves' Guild.
andor.50: Bucus has allowed me to enter the hatch in the derelict house in Fallhaven. I should go talk to Umar.
andor.51: Umar in the Fallhaven Thieves' Guild recognized me, but must have me confused with Andor. Apparently, Andor has been to see him.
andor.55: Umar told me that Andor went to see a potion maker called Lodar. I should search for his hideaway.
andor.61: I heard a story in Loneford, where it seemed like Andor had been in Loneford, and that he might have had something to do with the illness that the people are suffering from there. I am not sure if it actually was Andor. If it was Andor, why would he have made the people of Loneford ill?
andor.62: Andor might have gone to do some business with a rich man in Brimhaven after he left Loneford.
andor.65: It looks like Andor was involved in the destruction of the Brimhaven dam.
andor.70: I have found the potion-maker Lodar, and heard his story about Andor. Andor went to visit Lodar in his hideaway to get a sample of something called Narwood extract. Lodar happened to notice that there was someone travelling together with Andor, that hid among the trees and did not seem to want Lodar to spot him.
andor.71: Shortly after Andor and the person he was travelling with had left, strange things started to happen in the woods around Lodar's hideaway, and Lodar himself seemed to be affected by it somehow. Lodar believes that something disturbed the tomb below his cabin, and awoke the Hira'zinn.
andor.72: Since I helped Lodar defeat the Hira'zinn, he promised to help me in return. He gave me a piece of paper that should allow me to enter the Valanyr temple of the Shadow in Nor City. He told me to seek out lady Lydalon in the temple for further assistance.
andor.80: All clues so far as to where Andor went point to Nor City. I should travel to Nor City by following the Duleian road to the southeast and look for more clues there.
andor.85: Andor may have been in Stoutford.
andor.86: Andor had something to do with the demon under the church in Stoutford.
andor.90: At Castle Guynmart I learned from Steward Unkorh that some time ago Andor was also there as a guest.
andor.92: Unkorh gave me the bonemeal potion box that Andor had given him for safekeeping.
andor.100: While exploring the town of Sullengard, I so happened to stumble upon my mother and my aunt to whom I have never met. Mother has insisted that I go home so we can talk.
andor.110: After talking with mother back at home, she and I tried to brainstorm about where Andor could be. She reminded me about Andor's friend Stanwick who lives in Brightport. We agreed that going to talk to him might be the next logical thing to do.
andor.120: In the dungeons of Laeroth manor, Kotheses, the torturer, mentioned that he had taught Andor the basics of torturing.
andor.125: Vaelric confirmed that Andor visited him recently. Andor sought to learn Vaelric's skills and left quickly, clutching what he came for. His actions raise more questions about his intentions.
andor.126: In Brightport, I was finally able to meet Stanwick, but due to his hazy memory, he was not able to help me learn anything about the whereabouts of Andor.
andor.127: Regaining his peace of mind after I helped him, Stanwick said he'll tell me more about Andor, once he gathers his thoughts.
andor.128: Stanwick gave me a signet ring that I should show to his father. Jorwick, in Nor City.
andor.130: Andor was trying to find out from Seraphina about terrible monsters in the hideout near the place with the larval burrowers.
andor.131: Elysa in the Brightport's thieves guild told me that Andor has bought a map to the sewers of Feygard.
andor.132: While investigating the Brightport theft I learned from Bryma that Andor was the one who stole the important document, and brought it to her in exchange for her alchemy knowledge.
andor.140: I saw Andor in the mountains of Galmore. We were able to exchange a few words before he disappeared again.
andor.145: I met Andor on the road to Feygard, where he was buying food from Rosmara. He disappeared again.
andor.147: I met Andor on the road to Nor City, where he was buying supplies from Alynndir. He disappeared again.
andor.910: I decided to settle down on the top of Mt. Galmore. For this I needed to find a rich and discreet man to rebuild the ruins according to my wishes. Andor will now have to go and find himself.
andor.912: The construction contract for my new home was completed. I was curious to see what it would look like.
andor.914: I visited my new residence on the top of Mt. Galmore. There I would help the people of Dhayavar as a hero and protect them from villains. Or would I become a villain myself? We'll see.
andor.999: [Quest is not completable at this time.]

brv_flood.10: I found two not very bright brothers in a cellar of their house. They seemed to be talking about some sinister plan.
brv_flood.20: They were planning to destroy the great dam of Brimhaven. They just could not agree how they would do it.
brv_flood.30: They asked me to help them.
brv_flood.50: I have agreed to destroy the dam for them.
brv_flood.52: The brothers gave me a hand axe that could weaken the dam in a vulnerable place.
brv_flood.53: I took another hand axe. This time I shouldn't lose it.
brv_flood.54: I found the weak spot in the dam and started hacking at the wood.
brv_flood.56: Water came pouring through the hole in the dam. A lot of water!
brv_flood.70: I refused to destroy the dam for the brothers.
brv_flood.72: Given what I overheard, I was not allowed to leave. The two brothers attacked me.
brv_flood.80: Someone else destroyed the dam and water came pouring through a hole in the dam. A lot of water!
brv_flood.100: The Brimhaven guards have informed me that I may not leave the town until they have investigated who destroyed the dam.
brv_flood.110: I have promised to track down the real perpetrators. However, I still cannot leave the town.
brv_flood.120: The two brothers did not know their boss's name, but he seemed to have a lot of gold.
brv_flood.130: The rich man living up on the hill of Brimhaven seemed to know more than he admitted.
brv_flood.150: The rich man boasted that he had been bribed by an important man in Loneford to sabotage the dam.
brv_flood.200: I gave the letters as a piece of evidence to the captain of the guard. Now it is up to them to deal with the rich man.

place_to_forge.10: Nocmar refused to forge heartsteel in his shop, fearing discovery by Geomyr's men. He revealed that he once owned a glowing white house south of Fallhaven, where a special forge still burns. That forge was the only place he ever worked heartsteel. But after falling into debt, he lost the house to Alkapoan. If Nocmar is to forge again, I must help him regain it.
place_to_forge.20: Nocmar told me that Alkapoan holds the deed and key to the glowing white house. He said the forge within never dies, always blazing, ready for work. If I can reclaim the deed and key from Alkapoan, Nocmar will finally have his forge back.
place_to_forge.30: Alkapoan scoffed when I mentioned Nocmar. He said the only way to reclaim the glowing white house is to pay him fifty thousand gold. Nothing else will satisfy him.
place_to_forge.35: I told Alkapoan I wanted the glowing white house for myself. He agreed to sell it for forty thousand gold, but only if I first complete a task for him to prove my worth.
place_to_forge.40: Alkapoan asked me to collect an overdue 'operation tax' of five thousand gold from a card dealer in the back room of Brimhaven's tavern. I'll need to go there and retrieve the gold for Alkapoan before he will sell me the deed to the white house for forty thousand.
place_to_forge.45: I was able to collect the overdue 'operation tax' from the dealer and now I should return to Alkapoan.
place_to_forge.50: After I paid Alkapoan, he gave me the deed and the key to the white house south of Fallhaven. I should bring them back to Nocmar.
place_to_forge.60: I was able to finally give Nocmar back what was rightfully his...possession of his forge house.
